titles.title: Branches with Sun

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A long tree branch is depicted in a linear fashion along the left side of the paper.  Portions of other branches also occupy the upper right corner of the work.  In the midst of some light charcoal shading around the branches, a lighter circular spot has been created by erasing a bit of the charcoal.
